主要内容: Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. announced a private offering of $350 million in senior notes due 2026, exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933. The company also plans to refinance its existing senior secured credit facilities with a new $700 million credit agreement, including a $500 million revolving line of credit and a $200 million bank term loan. Proceeds from the offering and new credit facility will be used to refinance outstanding debt and pay related fees. The Advanced Materials & Structures segment, established in 2013, focuses on resin-based rolled goods for filtration, transportation, infrastructure & construction, medical, and industrial end-markets, aiming to diversify from its historical concentration in the tobacco industry. The filing highlights the risks and uncertainties associated with the Company's ability to consummate the offering of the Notes, as outlined in its 2017 annual report on Form 10-K and other SEC filings. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include SWM.
